text: The rich lie awake at night worrying about their money, and they waste away from lack of rest.
It is hard to fall asleep when you are very sick or worried about money.
The rich work hard and get richer, then they rest in luxury.
But the poor work hard and barely earn a living, and if they rest, they become even poorer.
Some people love gold and aim to make big profits, and they will be led to do wrong instead of right.
Because of gold, many lives have been ruined or have ended in destruction.
Money controls those fools who worship it.
God will bless those rich people who do only what is right and don't try to get richer.
If you ever find such people, you should honor them for doing the impossible.
When tested by money, who can always do right? When people could cheat to get more money but instead are honest, they have something to boast about.
The community will honor them for the kind things they do, and their wealth will grow.
When you go to a banquet, don't stuff yourself just because so much food is on the table.
Some people's eyes want everything they see. Is anything more evil? Such eyes will have plenty of tears.
Don't reach out and grab the food you want or push others aside.
Be thoughtful of others— they have feelings too.
Eat what is served, but you won't be welcome if you gobble it up like an animal.
Show good manners; stop eating before others do. If you keep on eating, they will be offended.
And in a large group of people, don't be the first one to reach for the serving dish.
Train yourself to be satisfied with a little food, and later, in bed, you will not be in pain when you try to breathe.
You will sleep well and wake up early, feeling good. But overeating causes cramps, as well as an upset stomach and sleepless nights.
If your host makes you overeat, leave the table and vomit— you will feel much better.
Listen to me! Pay attention, and later on, you will thank me. Don't try to eat[66] too much,[67] and you will stay healthy.
It is right to honor those who are generous with food at their dinner parties.
But the whole town is right to complain about a host who gives only a snack.
Wine has destroyed many lives, and heavy drinking is no way to prove you are strong.
The strength of iron is seen when it is heated, then dipped in water. And people show their arrogance when they argue after drinking wine.
A little wine is refreshing, and to live without wine is hardly living at all. God created wine to make us happy.
A little wine at the right time helps us celebrate.
But drinking too much wine leads us to hate others and to take revenge.[68]
When fools are drunk, they become angry and fight, but their strength is gone, and so they get hurt.
Don't scold your friends or be disgusted when they drink and celebrate at a party. And don't make them feel bad or upset them with a reminder that they owe you money.
